extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and FederalRegister.gov users who want to submit comments on federal rulemaking
extracted.subtask_short: submitting comments on Federal Register documents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on how and where to submit formal comments on rules, proposed rules, and notices published in the Federal Register, including which site tools are appropriate and which are not. Also explains navigation tips and the site's legal/status limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Regulations.gov or agency dockets for formal comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Readers should submit formal comments on rules, proposed rules, and notices via our integration with Regulations.gov, to the agency dockets on Regulations.gov, or to other places identified under the 'Addresses' heading in Federal Register documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many documents posted on this site have a 'Submit a Formal Comment' button that allows users to submit a comment to Regulations.gov without leaving FederalRegister.gov. The Regulations.gov sidebar also features a link that takes users directly to the official comment pages on Regulations.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site Feedback and Federal Register email are NOT for rulemaking comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Our 'Site Feedback' tool and Federal Register email addresses are only intended for users to submit technical questions and comments on the functionality of the FederalRegister.gov website. These tools cannot be used to submit comments on rulemaking actions or to petition agencies on public policy issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site has no authority or ability to process comments on regulations and notices or to answer questions on the substance of agency actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive comments submitted via wrong channels will not be forwarded
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive comments on rules and notices mistakenly submitted to FederalRegister.gov as feedback, blog comments, and user help email will not be passed on to the official agency comment docket.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you submit substantive comments to Regulations.gov or to the agency addresses specified in the Federal Register document to have them included in the official docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: 'Submit a Formal Comment' button and Regulations.gov link integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Many documents posted on this site include a 'Submit a Formal Comment' button and a Regulations.gov sidebar link that connect users to the official comment pages on Regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these integrated links/buttons to submit comments directly to the appropriate agency docket without leaving FederalRegister.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: 'For Further Information Contact' directs to agency officials
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'For Further Information Contact' headings in the Federal Register direct users to agency officials who can answer specific questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the contacts listed under this heading in a Federal Register document when you need specific information about the notice or rule from the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult USA.gov for general agency questions and contact directories
rubrics_metrics.description: For general questions and comments on government agencies’ policies and actions, consult USA.gov for a directory of federal and state contacts and frequently asked questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: FederalRegister.gov is an unofficial prototype; verify against official editions
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype 'Web 2.0' version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO’s govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents posted are XML renditions and each includes a link to the corresponding official PDF file on govinfo.gov. Until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register grants it official status, the XML rendition does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts. Verify results against an official edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigation: search tips for finding Federal Register items
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter a search term or FR citation (examples: '88 FR 382', '2024-13208', agency names, dates, etc.). Choosing an item from full text search results will bring you to those results; pressing enter in the search box will also bring you to search results; choosing an item from suggestions will bring you directly to the content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background and more details on searching and navigation are available in the Search & Navigation guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reader Aids are informational and not published in the Federal Register
rubrics_metrics.description: Reader Aids help people use FederalRegister.gov and understand the federal rulemaking process. Reader Aids information is not published in the Federal Register.
